title: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] CIT v. Sample Assessee Ltd.
headnote: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] Landmark ruling regarding eligibility criteria for statutory deductions under Section 80C.
keyHoldings: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] Deposit made prior to due date of filing return under Section 139(1) is eligible.
summary: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] Supreme Court held that statutory compliance before due date satisfies deduction prerequisites.

title: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] ABC Enterprises v. ACIT
headnote: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] Interplay between buyer TDS under Section 194Q and seller TCS under Section 206C(1H).
keyHoldings: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] Section 194Q takes priority over Section 206C(1H) once buyer deducts TDS.
summary: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] ITAT held that seller cannot collect TCS once buyer has deducted TDS under Section 194Q.

title: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] CIT v. Residential Home Investments
headnote: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] Purchase of two residential flats converted into single residential unit eligible for Section 54 exemption.
keyHoldings: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] Adjacent flats used as a single residential house qualify for exemption under Section 54.
summary: [DEMO PLACEHOLDER] High Court allowed Section 54 exemption for purchase of adjacent flats merged into one house.
